scope: Third matrix batch: address and bogus-nxdomain eligible; local endpoint gaps retained separately, not qualified.

checklist.boundary: Grammar: numeric IPv4/IPv6, multiple domains and repeated literals, # zero addresses, empty endpoint, leading dots, character/label wildcards, empty/hash/star global domain and explicit dotless domain; invalid address/domain rejection.

Longest suffix and exact-vs-wildcard precedence; label-boundary versus character wildcard; longer literal family mismatch falls back according to C, including same-tier numeric upstream and shorter-tier literal.
IN A/AAAA/ANY family priority; TXT/MX/DS/DNSKEY and non-IN classes; dotless DS parent/DNSKEY exclusion; root name does not match dotless.
Empty literal NXDOMAIN for unknown name; NODATA for existing local name or existing other-family literal; local host-record/CNAME answers override address routing.
Local literals are exempt from upstream bogus/rebind checks; numeric server carve-out overrides broader literal. Compare UDP/TCP and EDNS/DO envelopes, flags, TTL, RR order and exact question bytes.

Local-only causal guards require zero upstream packets; numeric carve-outs require one unchanged outbound query apart from transaction ID. Mutated address, flags, upstream count or missing row must fail.

source: dns/cache transaction predecessor DNS_BOGUS_CACHE_PHASE.md (reference guidance only)

checklist.boundary: Grammar: IPv4/IPv6 singleton and prefixes, max width and representative in/out subnet boundaries, repeated entries, invalid IP/prefix and empty argument; image IPv4 /0 and empty prefix act as /32, IPv6 /0 matches all.
Only IN A/AAAA in answer section trigger; non-IN and authority/additional-only addresses do not. CNAME target owner and unrelated owner matches retain C scan semantics.

Bogus check runs after alias but before rebind; local records exempt. NXDOMAIN, non-success RCODE, opcode and TC bypass; earlier match versus malformed address/RDLENGTH boundary preserves source scan order.
Blocked result is NXDOMAIN with AA cleared, answer/authority discarded and EDNS EDE behavior preserved. Compare UDP/TCP, client DO/AD/CD and raw upstream CD.

Independent bogus negative-cache insertion ignores no-negcache and both CD guards; A/AAAA cold plus plain replay proves absence of a second upstream query. Ordinary nonmatching replies retain normal CD cache restrictions.

TCP cold response publication followed by UDP replay, positive/zero TTL and expiry/recovery, matching owner and alias/rebind composition. Preserve exact TTL by bounded same-second pairs rather than normalizing it.
Negative controls must detect omitted packet, changed RCODE/address/TTL, incorrect cache hit/miss or missing upstream send; startup/test text and runtime identity/cleanup remain strict.
